verdict.rationale: Zamzar's pricing page documents a per-plan maximum file size (1MB, 50MB, Unlimited), so developers can size uploads against their tier. The only duration-related item is an SDK default wait timeout of 60 seconds, which is a client-side wait, not a documented job-duration limit. Nothing documents concurrency limits. Missing for 10: documented job duration/processing-time limits, documented concurrency or rate limits, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, file-size, duration, and concurrency limits are documented, so I can size jobs before hitting a wall
